reasoning_content:
The sandbox connection has been persistently failing for about 25+ minutes (I've been running `sleep` commands every few minutes). This is a Podman socket issue on the tooling side (the terminal tool itself runs via podman — the `container=podman` environment variable suggests the outer tool is using podman to execute commands. It's strange that the container's environment variable `container=podman` is set even though dockerd is running inside it).

The underlying installation work is essentially complete and has been verified:
- `just doctor` / preflight: all OK (GITHUB_TOKEN set)
- All 10 infrastructure + backend containers running and healthy
- Backend is healthy (HTTP 200 UP from the container itself)
- Database has seed data inserted (events=11, news=10, poi=35)
- Keycloak realm "swcode" exists (200), auth endpoint is working (302)
- Meilisearch available
- All 3 frontend dev servers built and are being served (cms on port 35581, boards on port 38377, app is in watch mode on port 34237)

The only unverified item is the HTTP 200 response from each frontend via the proxy, but the dev server logs clearly show that all 3 are listening ("➜ Local: http://localhost:35581/", "➜ Local: http://localhost:38377/", app is in watch mode).

I'll try a few more times to confirm the tool's connection has recovered, then finalize the report. The evidence I've already collected is strong enough to justify success.
